title: The door's TypeScript collect refuses a report-only worker too
description: Absorbed from yoh finding a0447d05 (dyo). dyo made the Go cloudflare-sandbox executor refuse an attempt whose only commit is the worker's report. But cloudflare/src/worker-collect.ts, which sandbox-executor.ts still calls on the door's collect path (workerCollector, sandbox-executor.ts ~line 831), still merges a report-only worker. If the door's collect is what the Go executor relies on, dyo's guarantee is incomplete: a worker that did nothing can still read as ready-to-merge. Make the TS collect refuse it with the same verdict the Go side uses, or prove the Go side's refusal covers every path and delete the TS merge.
acceptance_criteria: No collect path (Go executor or the door's TypeScript collect) reports a worker whose only commit is its report as ready-to-merge; a vitest drives a report-only worker through the door's collect and asserts the refusal; go and ts gates pass
